sources.label: De-Vanced exists because the old way started getting frustrating, so I migrated
sources.author: De-Vanced
patch_list: Disable typing indicator
Disables the indicator while typing a message.
Hide Facebook buttons
Hides buttons and shortcuts that open Facebook.
Hide inbox ads
Hides ads in inbox.
Hide inbox stories and notes tray
Hides the stories and notes horizontal tray at the top of the inbox.
Hide inbox subtabs
Hides Home and Channels tabs between active now tray and chats.
Open links externally
Always opens links in your default browser instead of the in-app browser, regardless of the in-app setting.
Remove Meta AI
Removes UI elements related to Meta AI.
Spoof package version
Sets a very high version code so the Play Store treats the app as already up to date and never offers an update.

sources.label: New mask, same task.
sources.author: Doom
patch_list: Allow screen capture
Allows screenshots and screen recording in all conversations including end-to-end encrypted ones.
Block screenshot detection
Prevents Messenger from notifying other participants when you take a screenshot or screen recording.
Change package name
Installs Messenger beside the original by renaming the manifest package and provider authorities, removing duplicate permission declarations.
Disable media transcoding
Sends photos and videos at original quality without re-encoding.
Disable typing indicator
Disables the indicator while typing a message.
Enable chat heads
Enables chat heads (bubbles) for all devices regardless of API level or RAM class.
Hide Facebook buttons
Hides buttons and shortcuts that open Facebook.
Hide inbox ads
Hides ads in the Messenger inbox.
Hide inbox stories and notes tray
Hides the stories and notes horizontal tray at the top of the inbox.
Hide inbox subtabs
Hides Home and Channels tabs between active now tray and chats.
Open links externally
Opens links in the external browser instead of the in-app browser.
Remove Meta AI
Removes the Meta AI floating button, drawer items, and search suggestions.
Spoof package version
Sets a very high version code so the Play Store treats the app as already up to date and never offers an update.

Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent, and marks the ones that were. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. A clock next to the new message button in Chats can open…

Keeps a copy of Messenger working when another patch gives it a new package name. Without it the copy stops at its loading screen, and its attachments and muted chats go to the Messenger it was copied from. HushMessenger's own Clone instal…

Notify for restricted chats

Chats with people you've restricted notify you like your other chats. A chat you've muted stays quiet. Restricted people still can't see when you're active or when you've read their messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger setting…

Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Open your gallery app

The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Pick several and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and that chat at the top. Start…

Lets you pin chats past Messenger's limit and puts Pin back on chats that don't offer it. Pins past the limit stay on this phone, so they won't show on your other devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Play video links in the chat

Plays a shared YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Facebook video in a window over the chat instead of sending you to the app or the browser. The video comes from the site's own player, so nothing is downloaded and the window keeps no cookies. S…
Preview chats on long press

Pressing and holding a chat opens Messenger's own preview of it, with the chat's menu underneath, so you can peek at a chat without opening it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

With Open your gallery app on, what you pick goes into the chat's message box the way Messenger's own gallery puts it there, instead of the editor or the Send to sheet. Nothing goes out until you tap Send. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMes…
Put your words above the photo

Type something, attach a photo or video, and your words go out first, as their own message above it, instead of underneath. Mentions still work. With nothing typed, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Contro…
Quiet incoming calls

Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. Only chosen chats keeps this to the ch…
Quiet mode

A break from Messenger. Pick 15 minutes, an hour, two hours, eight hours or until you end it yourself, and nothing from Messenger makes a sound or vibrates for that long. Messages and calls still arrive and wait in the notification shade,…
Record calls

Adds a Record button over Messenger during a call. The call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of…
Restore old emoji drawer

Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Restore screens on re-signed builds

Pick the refresh rate Messenger asks your screen for. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

Send videos without re-encoding

Show settings tab

Show the 40-character code option
Bring back the 40-character recovery code row in Message storage. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Skip passkey sign-in

Slide chats in and out
Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Sound in the open chat

Plays Messenger's in-app message sound when a message comes into the chat you have open. Messenger already does that for likes and stickers. A silent phone or Messenger's own In-app sounds switch still keeps it quiet. Starts off. Turn it o…
Special contacts

Adds Track this person to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat with one person. HushMessenger then keeps a history of when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, from what Messenger already shows you. T…
Spoof package version

Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, w…
Square profile pictures

Shows profile pictures as squares instead of circles, or as rounded squares with Round the corners on. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Stop ad attribution uploads
Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Stop analytics uploads

Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Stop app list and device ID sharing

Stops Messenger from going through the apps on your phone to find other Meta apps, and from asking them for the device ID Meta uses to link the apps on one phone. Messenger keeps the ID it already has. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMesseng…
Stop attention time logging

Stops the report Messenger files when you leave a screen, which says how long you looked at each thing on it, in what order, and how often you came back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Stop inbox and ad link logging

Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMesseng…
Stop live connection logging

Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off.…
Stop nearby scans

Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you, and hides the name and hardware address of the one you're connected to, the way Android does when Messenger can't see your location. Also stops the timer it can run while…
Swipe between tabs

Swipe sideways on your chats to move to the next tab in the bar at the bottom, instead of reaching down for its button. Hidden tabs are skipped, and a list that scrolls sideways keeps the swipe. Restart Messenger after you turn it on. Star…
Thin story rings
Draws the colored ring around a profile picture with a story at half its usual width, so it takes less room. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Translucent chat bars

The chat's top bar and message box go see-through, with the messages scrolling under them and showing through blurred, the way the bars on an iPhone do it. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Contr…
Typing in your chat list

Use system emoji

Use the phone's camera app

Use your own font

Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Contro…
View stories anonymously

Write longer notes
Type more than 60 characters in a note. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
Your own home header

Puts words or a picture of your own at the top of the chat list in place of Messenger's wordmark. Type the words or pick the picture in HushMessenger settings. With neither, the wordmark stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger setti…
Your own tab icons

Swaps the icons in the bar at the bottom for plain outlined ones, and lets you put your own picture on any tab. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
